name: Slither Rock
summary: Cyrus Therepentous keeps to Slither Rock in the far northeastern cliffs of the Burning Steppes. Beyond the perilous Terror Wing Path, the cave is his solitary refuge, and his sharp tongue masks an agenda of his own.

sections.title: A Secluded Cavern
sections.body:
Beyond the Terror Wing Path, Slither Rock lies among the scorched crags of the Burning Steppes. Far from Blackrock Spire's roaring forges and marching orc warbands, this remote hollow shelters Cyrus Therepentous, a solitary black dragonspawn.

Dragonspawn usually serve the Black Dragonflight with fierce loyalty, but Cyrus keeps apart from his kin. He speaks with mortal travelers instead of killing them on sight. Yet every exchange brings an insult.

faq.answer: Slither Rock lies in the far northeastern corner of the Burning Steppes. To reach it, travelers must pass the black dragonkin patrolling the Terror Wing Path.
Cyrus Therepentous, a solitary black dragonspawn, lives in the cave. Unlike most of his kin, he speaks with outsiders instead of attacking at once, though his temper is foul and his words derisive.

faq.q: Why would an adventurer seek out this cave?
faq.answer: Adventurers brave the perilous Terror Wing Path to seek Cyrus Therepentous's counsel and aid. Despite his abrasive manner, he helps them vanquish a common foe, with rude and derisive comments along the way.
